spanish: Y alzó su comparación y dijo: Levántate, Balaq, y oye; presta oído a mí, hijo de Tsipor.

findings.issue: בְּנוֹ is tagged noun singular construct with a 3ms suffix (his son). Spanish 'hijo de Tsipor' drops that suffix and makes Tsipor the genitive father.

notes: Narrative 3ms and the 2ms imperatives match; Balaq and Tsipor are not locked in PROPER_NAMES.md.
